stem_book: A stone is projected upward with a velocity of 20 ms⁻¹. The air resistance causes a deceleration of 2 ms⁻² (constant, opposing the motion; take g = 10 ms⁻²). Then (one or more correct), (a) the maximum height attained by the stone is 16.67 m (b) the time of flight of stone is 3.7 s (c) the speed with which it will strike the ground is zero (d) the acceleration during down motion is 8 ms⁻²
key: abd (a) the maximum height attained by the stone is 16.67m. (b) the time of flight of stone is 3.7 s. (d) the acceleration during down motion is 8 ms⁻².
reason: g = 10 ms⁻² and 'resistance opposes motion' are unstated in print; added to stem.
